tagline: Isaan's hub city — dinosaurs, Bueng Kaen Nakhon lake, and countryside mudmee silk
introHtml: Khon Kaen is a big city in the heart of Isaan that people are always passing through. Bueng Kaen Nakhon, a lake right in the middle of town, is where locals jog and sit out for the evening breeze. The Phu Wiang Dinosaur Museum sits on a site where real fossils were dug up nearby. There are villages that weave mudmee silk out in the countryside, plus a big annual silk festival. And around town you'll find cafes and Isaan restaurants where you can sit all day. If you want an Isaan trip in a city that has everything sorted, Khon Kaen works.
bestTime: November–February, cool and comfortable — lines up with the silk festival and the city's seasonal events

highlights.name: Bueng Kaen Nakhon
highlights.blurb: A lake in the middle of town that doubles as the city's park. In the evening people come to jog, cycle, and sit eating by the water.

highlights.name: Phu Wiang Dinosaur Museum
highlights.blurb: A real dinosaur fossil dig site in Wiang Kao district, with skeletons and models that get kids excited.

highlights.name: Wat Nong Waeng (Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon)
highlights.blurb: A nine-tier pagoda beside Bueng Kaen Nakhon — climb to the top floor for a wide view over the city and the lake.

highlights.name: Mudmee silk and the silk festival
highlights.blurb: Khon Kaen is known for mudmee silk, with weaving villages and a big annual silk festival late in the year.

highlights.name: Khao Niao Road
highlights.blurb: The nightlife strip in the city center, full of restaurants and bars — and the liveliest Songkran water-fight spot in town.

highlights.name: Ubol Ratana Dam
highlights.blurb: A large dam on a wide stretch of water, with floating riverside restaurants and a sunset viewpoint where people settle in for a while.

foodScene.name: Isaan food
foodScene.note: Som tam, larb, koi, nam tok, grilled chicken — you'll find them in every corner of town, bold and full-on the way real Isaan food should be.

foodScene.name: Grilled chicken and som tam by the lake
foodScene.note: Grilled chicken and som tam stalls line the edge of Bueng Kaen Nakhon — easy to sit and eat in the cool breeze by the water.

foodScene.name: Mam and Isaan sausage
foodScene.note: Tangy fermented meats eaten with sticky rice and fresh vegetables — both a snack and a classic local souvenir.

foodScene.name: Sticky rice and grilled snacks on Khao Niao Road
foodScene.note: A nightlife strip packed with grilled and fried snacks plus bars to sit at — good for a long evening of grazing.

foodScene.name: Moo kratha and jim jum
foodScene.note: Moo kratha grills and jim jum hot pots are everywhere in town — a go-to dinner for locals in Khon Kaen.

foodScene.name: Cafes and coffee in town
foodScene.note: Khon Kaen has plenty of cafes both downtown and around the university — fine for working or taking photos all day.

foodScene.name: Khanom jeen and Vietnamese kuay jap
foodScene.note: Khanom jeen with curry sauce and the wide-noodle Vietnamese kuay jap, found at morning markets and old-school shops.

attractions.name: Bueng Kaen Nakhon
attractions.blurb: A lake in the middle of town with a running track and a waterside park — the main evening hangout for locals in Khon Kaen.

attractions.name: Phu Wiang Dinosaur Museum
attractions.blurb: A dinosaur study center in Phu Wiang park, with fossils found on site and a walking trail past the excavation pits.

attractions.name: Wat Nong Waeng
attractions.blurb: Phra Mahathat Kaen Nakhon, a nine-tier pagoda beside the lake — climb up for city views and modern Isaan-style architecture.

attractions.name: Ubol Ratana Dam
attractions.blurb: A wide reservoir with floating riverside restaurants and a sunset viewpoint with a nice atmosphere.

attractions.name: Phu Kao–Phu Phan Kham National Park
attractions.blurb: Mountains and viewpoints above Ubol Ratana Dam, with rock platforms and nature walking trails.

attractions.name: Ban Khok Sa-nga Cobra Village
attractions.blurb: A well-known snake-show village in Nam Phong district, with performances and the story of the bond between people and cobras.

attractions.name: Phra That Kham Kaen
attractions.blurb: An old landmark stupa in Nam Phong district — the source of Khon Kaen's name and revered by locals.

attractions.name: City pillar shrine and old town quarter
attractions.blurb: The heart of town with the city pillar shrine, markets, and old shops — a pleasant place to stroll and watch local life.
